chunks: He was asked about the muhrim sleeping on his face while he was on his mount, so he said: “There is no harm in that.”

key_terms.الْمُحْرِمِ: a person in the state of ihram for hajj or 'umrah
key_terms.لَا بَأْسَ: there is no harm; it is permissible

ai.seo_question: Is it permissible for a muhrim to sleep on his face while riding his mount?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning the conduct of a muhrim during hajj or 'umrah. It states that there is no harm in a muhrim sleeping on his face while riding his mount, indicating the permissibility of this specific act in the state of ihram.
